From fe4447cd95623b1cfacc15f280aab73a6d7340b2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yuqi Xu <xuyuqiabc@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 13:12:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] rxrpc: reject undecryptable rxkad response tickets

rxkad_decrypt_ticket() decrypts the RXKAD response ticket and then
parses the buffer as plaintext without checking whether
crypto_skcipher_decrypt() succeeded.

A malformed RESPONSE can therefore use a non-block-aligned ticket
length, make the decrypt operation fail, and still drive the ticket
parser with attacker-controlled bytes.

Check the decrypt result and abort the connection with RXKADBADTICKET
when ticket decryption fails.

Fixes: 17926a79320a ("[AF_RXRPC]: Provide secure RxRPC sockets for use by userspace and kernel both")
Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>
Co-developed-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Suggested-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Tested-by: Ren Wei <enjou1224z@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuqi Xu <xuyuqiabc@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: David Howells <dhowells@redhat.com>
cc: Marc Dionne <marc.dionne@auristor.com>
cc: Simon Horman <horms@kernel.org>
cc: linux-afs@lists.infradead.org
cc: stable@kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260408121252.2249051-12-dhowells@redhat.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/rxrpc/rxkad.c b/net/rxrpc/rxkad.c
index e923d6829008..0f79d694cb08 100644
--- a/net/rxrpc/rxkad.c
+++ b/net/rxrpc/rxkad.c
@@ -958,6 +958,7 @@ static int rxkad_decrypt_ticket(struct rxrpc_connection *conn,
 	struct in_addr addr;
 	unsigned int life;
 	time64_t issue, now;
+	int ret;
 	bool little_endian;
 	u8 *p, *q, *name, *end;
 
@@ -977,8 +978,11 @@ static int rxkad_decrypt_ticket(struct rxrpc_connection *conn,
 	sg_init_one(&sg[0], ticket, ticket_len);
 	skcipher_request_set_callback(req, 0, NULL, NULL);
 	skcipher_request_set_crypt(req, sg, sg, ticket_len, iv.x);
-	crypto_skcipher_decrypt(req);
+	ret = crypto_skcipher_decrypt(req);
 	skcipher_request_free(req);
+	if (ret < 0)
+		return rxrpc_abort_conn(conn, skb, RXKADBADTICKET, -EPROTO,
+					rxkad_abort_resp_tkt_short);
 
 	p = ticket;
 	end = p + ticket_len;
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### Modifications in `net/rxrpc/rxkad.c`

- **Added error checking for decryption**:  
  The return value of `crypto_skcipher_decrypt()` is now stored in a local variable `ret`. Previously, the call was made without checking its success status.

- **Connection abort on decryption failure**:  
  If `ret` is negative (indicating a decryption error), the connection is immediately aborted using `rxrpc_abort_conn()` with the error code `RXKADBADTICKET`. This prevents the code from continuing to parse the ticket buffer as plaintext when decryption has failed.

### Relationship Between Changes

The single change in `rxkad.c` addresses a security vulnerability: a malformed response ticket with a non-block-aligned length could cause `crypto_skcipher_decrypt()` to fail, yet the code would continue to interpret the unmodified (attacker-controlled) buffer as a valid decrypted ticket. By checking the decryption result and aborting the connection on failure, the patch ensures that only correctly decrypted tickets are processed, closing the potential attack vector.
